startUrl.title: Start URL
startUrl.description: The page the crawl starts from, usually the root of the documentation (e.g. `https://docs.apify.com/cli/docs`). Only pages under this URL path are included.

maxCrawlDepth.title: Max crawl depth
maxCrawlDepth.description: How many links away from the start page to go. `1` includes the pages linked from the start page (usually the whole navigation of a docs site), `2` also the pages linked from those.

maxCrawlPages.title: Max crawl pages
maxCrawlPages.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl. Pages are picked in navigation order, so the most prominent pages are crawled first.

excludeUrlGlobs.title: Exclude URLs
excludeUrlGlobs.description: Glob patterns of URLs to skip, e.g. `*/docs/1.*` for old documentation versions. `*` matches any characters including `/`.

generateLlmsFullTxt.title: Generate llms-full.txt
generateLlmsFullTxt.description: Also generate `llms-full.txt` with the full content of all pages as Markdown. Uses the Markdown version of a page when the site provides one, otherwise converts the HTML.

linkToMarkdown.title: Link to Markdown versions of pages
linkToMarkdown.description: When a page advertises a Markdown version (`<link rel="alternate" type="text/markdown">`), link to it in `llms.txt` instead of the HTML page. AI agents read Markdown faster and cheaper.

aiCuration.title: Curate with AI
aiCuration.description: Use an LLM to group pages by what a developer wants to do, write the summary and move secondary pages to the Optional section. Runs through the Apify OpenRouter proxy and is billed to your Apify account (usually well under $0.01 per run on paid plans). Only works on the Apify platform.

aiModel.title: AI model
aiModel.description: OpenRouter model ID used for AI curation. Prefer instruct/non-reasoning models: a reasoning model can spend the 2,048-token response budget on hidden reasoning before writing the JSON and get cut off.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Most documentation sites work without a proxy, which is also faster. Enable Apify Proxy if the site blocks the crawler.
